messages:
talia: Heads-up: new enterprise insists on customer-supplied HSM import. Sales needs a short FAQ for legal: RBAC escalation windows, signed audit evidence, and what we do on suspected operator compromise. tagging @mitch @rohan

mitch: Summary suggestion: 1) Strict separation: `kms-config` (admin), `import-operator` (timeboxed, dual-ack where possible), `audit-viewer` (readonly). 2) All import ops require a ticket ID + 2 approvers or a pre-approved JIT token.

rohan: On JIT: use STS session with tags: ticket_id, approver_ids, ttl. Reject imports if ticket_id missing. TTL = 2h by default. Add MFA + hardware token requirement for any import action.

claire: Audit evidence: daily signed bundles (ed25519) + RFC3161 timestamp. Bundle must include HSM serial + firmware SHA256 + vendor attestation when available. Store in Object Lock (governance) and mirror to customer if requested.

talia: Legal asked about provable tamper-resistance. Is merkle + timestamp needed or is signature + TSA enough?

claire: Recommend merkle root included for per-event verification, plus RFC3161 timestamp on the root. That gives per-event inclusion proofs and tamper detection. Also publish the merkle root to our transparency topic (read-only) each day.

mitch: Vulnerability triage: add pre-import allowlist: proxy must receive `X-HSM-FW-SHA256` and `X-HSM-SERIAL`. If model/firmware on denylist -> block import and open P0. If firmware unknown -> block until attestation provided.

alert-bot: advisory: vendor-hsm-cve-2025-9987 detected for modules "Orion-3" and "Orion-4". Please verify pre-import allowlist.

rohan: IR shortflow to include in SOW: 1) immediate RBAC revoke for suspect operator (<=2m), 2) automated snapshot + signed export (<=6h), 3) block further imports from that HSM model if vendor CVE confirmed, 4) rewrap flow and timeline to customer, 5) final signed forensic bundle and RCA within 72h.

talia: Can we promise 3yr immutable retention for audit bundles? customer asked for that length.

claire: Yes: Object Lock + lifecycle to cold archive (Glacier Deep) + cross-account notarization. Need to surface costs though. We'll include a cost appendix. Also keep signer cert chain and TSA responses in the bundle.

mitch: One more: dual-operator imports. Our proxy currently supports single-op only. Options: (a) require customer-supplied threshold HSM, (b) use manual dual-op process with witness logs + video proof (if customer mandates). Document both in onboarding checklist.

talia: Action items: Mitch -> RBAC/JIT policy sample and dual-op options; Rohan -> pre-import allowlist spec and auto-block logic; Claire -> signed bundle spec (merkle + RFC3161 + storage) and cost estimate. I'll create onboarding ticket and loop Legal. Shareable with Sales?

mitch: share away.

talia: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
